exposure: Group B streptococci (GBS) in urine culture during pregnancy (positive, negative, or not cultured)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 34,285 women with singleton pregnancies from the catchment area of Lillebaelt Hospital, Denmark, between January 2002 and December 2012.
finding: No association was found between asymptomatic GBS bacteriuria and preterm delivery among women with singleton pregnancies whose urine specimens were cultured during pregnancy, suggesting that previous findings may have been influenced by a selection bias.
